purpose: Minimal qualified bidirectional activation-patching pilot: does the candidate-end key-side encoding of appended conflict evidence (G4 readout localization) carry the causal signal for the appended-conflict recognition failure? Exploratory plumbing + selectivity probe on 2 equal-width hosts x 2 layers x 2 directions with a single qualified donor; NOT a mechanism proof and NOT a substitute for the 10x6 confirmation stage.

G3 two independent policy oracles agree on all 108 arms (old/new/SA x 36 pairs)
G4 author/round/block/chronology contracts on both appended messages of every pair
G5 native tokenizer parity: fresh full-sequence token ids SHA256 == archived token_ids_sha256 for 108/108 primary rows; appended-span anchors with trailing-suffix preservation
G6 exact +34 token width on all donor and host arms (fresh == archived lengths)

frozen_roster.roster_independence: 3 distinct source run groups (83/114/182); scenes from DEV corpus only (split asserted development); G3/A428 scene-level exclusions inherited from the V2 construction
frozen_roster.span_method: G4 G0C first-divergence anchor method: span = [z, len(new_ids) - (len(old_ids) - z)); trailing suffix (validator_set field tokens) asserted byte-identical after the span - fixes V3 review P0-1 (appended event is inside received_messages, NOT at the state end)

intervention.row_form: hybrid backbone runs every question as an independent causal row (state tokens + branch tokens); one native forward per condition; the conflicting_vote row (branch index resolved dynamically from meta, verified 1) is the only patched row
intervention.patch_site: backbone decoder-layer OUTPUT (register_forward_hook) at the C row, span positions equal to the appended-span state coordinates of the target arm
intervention.layer_selection_rationale: frozen in the pilot admission checklist BEFORE any patched forward: 23 = last decoder layer (readout-proximal), 11 = mid-depth; no post-hoc layer selection; no result-conditioned layer claims
intervention.width_policy: all spans exactly 34 tokens on both sides (verified G6); no interpolation or coordinate mapping needed
intervention.direction_A_restoration: donor NEW appended-span states (recognized evidence) -> host SA appended-span (neutral duplicate-vote context); question: does the host C read move toward / flip to true?
intervention.direction_B_suppression: failed-host treatment appended-span states -> donor NEW appended-span (recognized evidence); question: does the donor C read move away from / flip from true?
intervention.position_ids_note: injected states are layer-output hidden vectors; the injection site keeps the host's own position ids; donor and host span widths are equal (34), so no alignment mapping is applied

controls: host SA unpatched baselines (2), bitwise-checked against archived G1S V2 logits (run-to-run determinism)
donor NEW unpatched baseline (1), bitwise-checked against archived logits
identity self-patch at layer 11 (2): host SA span states patched back into the same span must reproduce the baseline bitwise (plumbing gate)
SA-sham cross (4): donor duplicate-vote SA span states (non-recognized evidence) into host SA span - negative control for restoration
position-permuted donor span states (4, fixed seed 20261025 permutation): scrambled-geometry control
off-target readouts: all four question heads recorded on every forward; off-target flip rates reported without selection

physical_forward_plan.reconciliation: predicted == observed_mock_trace == 28 (budget_reconciliation.json); auto-derived from the frozen roster x layers x conditions; no dynamic host pool
physical_forward_plan.note: 28 is a planned count under a fresh admission receipt, NOT a standing authorization; execution additionally requires the blind-review PASS and explicit user approval below

analysis_preregistered: primary readout: conflicting_vote margin = logits[true] - logits[false] on the C row, plus argmax read and p(true)
restoration effect per (host, layer): delta_margin = margin_patched - margin_host_SA_baseline; reported for both layers without selection

restoration is called supportive at (host, layer) ONLY if delta_margin > 0 AND delta_margin exceeds both the SA-sham cross and the position-permuted control at the same (host, layer); flips (false->true) reported separately

suppression effect per (host, layer): delta_margin = margin_patched - margin_donor_new_baseline; negative signed changes and flips reported; exploratory (no additional donor-side sham control within the 28-call budget)
off-target integrity: quorum / certificate_action / evidence_level margin changes on every patched forward reported descriptively

interpretation ceiling: even a fully supportive result is a single-donor, two-host, two-layer DEV exploratory causal probe consistent with the G4 key-side localization; it does not establish a general mechanism, cross-model generality, or deployment relevance

admission_requirements.blind_review_verdict: PASS (exact string, pinned to the runner git blob in admission_receipt_pilot_gpu.json)

gpu_gate.runner_self_check: the GPU runner hashes its own file with git hash-object and refuses to run unless it equals blind_review_runner_blob in the admission receipt
gpu_gate.crash_safety: every forward appends its raw row before the next starts; failures keep completed rows and write FAIL receipt with SHA256SUMS

stop_conditions: STOP_PRE_GPU_<GATE> from the CPU closed loop (any gate)
STOP_DETERMINISM (fresh baseline logits differ from archived)
STOP_SPAN_ALIGNMENT (suffix preservation or width violation at execution time)
